name: Torres del Paine
about: Trekking season runs Oct–Mar/Apr, when trails and refugios are open; most infrastructure closes for winter (Jun–Aug), and even in peak season this is one of the windiest places on Earth.
overview: Chile's flagship Patagonia park — granite towers, glaciers, and increasingly famous puma tracking, centered on the W and O treks.
costOverview: There's no cheap way to do the W or O trek — refugios, park fees, and transport all add up, and the small number of luxury lodges push the top end even higher.

costItems.label: W Trek refugio bed, half board

specialSeasons.text: Most refugios and campsites close for the winter — the park stays open but trekking infrastructure is minimal.
